# ThinkIac

> ThinkIac is a cloud platform and V8 runtime for building AI agents and full-stack
> web apps in a single environment. Plain JavaScript/TypeScript functions become
> infrastructure through JSDoc decorators, and packages communicate through an
> event bus instead of importing each other.

## What it is

- A **runtime**: one embedded V8 process runs your agents and your web apps together.
- **Decorator-driven**: a JSDoc comment turns a function into a tool, route, view or
  hook — `@register_tool`, `@register_router` or `@register_hook`.
- **Event-driven**: packages stay decoupled. They emit events with `$` (the exported
  shorthand for `dispatchEvent`) and any registered hook reacts. Example: a hook
  defines the `web:search` event, and both a tool and a route just call
  `$('web:search', { term })` — the logic lives in one place and can never drift.
- **Multi-provider LLMs**: route per request to OpenAI, Anthropic (direct or via
  OpenRouter) or DeepSeek. Cognitive features include a ReAct loop, loop-detection,
  hallucination-detection and MoIE (an edge LLM in pure Python, no GPU).
- **Store**: a marketplace to discover, install and publish packages.

## Platforms

- Windows desktop app (.exe) — available now.
- Android app (.apk) — available now.
- macOS, iOS and Linux — coming soon.
- Or run entirely in the cloud with no install.

## Pricing (hardware, not seats)

Every tenant runs in its own container sized by InfraKit. You pick a base tier and add
CPU, RAM and disk à la carte; the container is resized live. Prices shown in USD,
billed monthly in BRL.

- Free — 0.25 vCPU, 256 MB RAM, 1 GB disk — $0/mo
- Basic — 0.5 vCPU, 512 MB RAM, 5 GB disk — ~$3.62/mo
- Pro — 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 20 GB disk — ~$9.07/mo
- Add-ons: +0.25 vCPU (~$1.80/mo), +256 MB RAM (~$1.25/mo), +5 GB disk (~$0.89/mo)
